text:
claire (Design): Pushed a quick prototype for the latency dashboard grid + aggregation legend. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/latency-grid-v3 — main asks: where to surface sampling rate, how legend explains aggregated buckets, and how p95 tooltip reads.

zoe (Design Ops): Quick nit: labeling the control as `Sampling %` reads like a percentage value. Can we use `Sampling rate` or `Sampling level`? :thinking:

mike (Frontend): On feasibility: virtualized grid for heatmap is fine, but sticky legend columns + horizontal scroll needs careful repainting. I can do sticky left column for the legend, but we should avoid expensive reflows when toggling sampling.

jordan (Metrics): Also an analytics note: our p95 in these charts is currently computed on sampled requests (not full traffic). The tooltip needs to say that so customers don't assume it's exact. Suggest: `p95 (computed on sample)` or tooltip: `95th percentile over sampled requests — increasing sampling improves accuracy`.

anya (A11y): Color + contrast alert: the current green -> red ramp fails 3:1 contrast in the lighter buckets. We should use a color-blind safe palette and include an explicit legend label per bucket (e.g., `0–10ms`, `10–50ms`, etc.) for screen readers. Also ensure keyboard focus can land on the legend items and toggles.

sam (PM): Thanks — high priority for the next sprint. Can we get proposed tooltip copy, the legend microcopy, and a11y checklist (keyboard + aria) by EOD Friday? I want to decide if sampling presets are alpha or go/no-go. @mike @anya

claire (Design): Drafting copy here — feel free to iterate:

Tooltip (p95): `p95 — 95th percentile latency across requests. Calculated from sampled requests; increase sampling for higher accuracy.`
Sampling control label: `Sampling rate`
Sampling tooltip: `The fraction of requests used to compute latency aggregates. Higher sampling improves accuracy but increases cost.`
Legend header: `Latency bucket (ms)` with per-bucket labels in the legend popover.

zoe (Design Ops): For presets, propose `Low (1%)`, `Medium (5%)`, `High (20%)` instead of raw numbers. Less scary to new users. Copy for the tiny badge: `est. error` that surfaces approximate sampling error.

mike (Frontend): Implementation note — we can wire the `est. error` as a computed tooltip value; backend will pass an `error_estimate` in the aggregation payload. Quick CSS for sticky legend I tried:
```css
.latency-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 220px 1fr; }
.legend { position: sticky; left: 0; z-index: 3; background: var(--panel-bg); }
```
Should be straightforward, but watch for `transform` on parent elements — that kills sticky positioning.

engbot: Storybook published: https://staging.redwood/storybook/latency-grid-v3 — heatmap + legend stories uploaded. CI: green :white_check_mark:

anya (A11y): Also request: aria-labels for each legend row like `Latency bucket 10 to 50 milliseconds — color level 3`. And `aria-live` for the small streaming total token/time summaries so screen readers notice updates but don't spam.

claire (Design): Great — I'll update the Figma with the new legend labels + sampling presets and add the tooltip copy. Will include alt text examples for the legend rows too.

sam (PM): Great. Follow-ups: @mike to prototype sticky legend + est. error tooltip (due Wed). @anya to provide accessible color tokens + aria examples (due Thu). Claire to deliver updated figma and copy (EOD Friday).

mike (Frontend): Acknowledged — will post a short PR with the CSS and storybook link when ready. :eyes:
